## Why water matters

Brewed coffee is more than 98 percent water, so water quality changes the taste. Magnesium in the water helps pull flavour compounds out of the grounds.

## The standard

The Specialty Coffee Association recommends a total hardness of roughly 50 to 175 parts per million. Distilled water, with no minerals at all, makes flat, dull coffee.
